entries.00ef7e18512742b3: This business franchises the university preparatory cram school “Kawai Juku Manabis,” which combines video lessons with “learning navigation” (personal support) for current high school students. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥3,355 million, and as of September 30, 2025, consolidated subsidiary Shonan Zeminaru, as franchisee, operated 51 campuses nationwide.
entries.35f7a73d3fcc0604: These are businesses not included in reportable segments, including the operation and franchising of “Jiritsu Gakushu RED,” the online tutoring school “Sora-juku,” the development and sale of the “Foresta” series of learning materials, the adult dance school “Tokyo Dance Village,” and the operation of a Japanese language school and a programming proficiency test, among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥3,914 million. As of September 30, 2025, “Jiritsu Gakushu RED” operated 6 directly managed classrooms and 208 franchise classrooms.

entries.58e3efed22cd9505: An education services company that provides cram schools and education-related services, centered on the individual tutoring school "Morijuku."
entries.b579070d8ac7367a: This business operates “Mori-juku,” a tutoring-style cram school for elementary, junior high and high school students in which one teacher instructs up to two students. For junior high school students, it has introduced a “grade guarantee program” that guarantees a rise of 20 points or more in one subject on regular exams. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥18,562 million, and as of September 30, 2025, it operated 249 directly managed campuses.
entries.caa7654c93821f97: This business operates the cram school “Shonan Zeminaru,” which mainly uses group instruction for elementary, junior high and high school students.
entries.d4e7f28c95b09079: This business operates “Mori-juku,” a tutoring-style cram school for elementary, junior high and high school students in which one teacher instructs up to two students.
entries.fbdb0a38d231e20f: This business operates the cram school “Shonan Zeminaru,” which mainly uses group instruction for elementary, junior high and high school students. It offers various courses, from regular exam preparation to preparation for entrance exams to highly competitive schools, using its original “QE” lesson style. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥9,295 million, and as of September 30, 2025, it operated 200 campuses, centered on Kanagawa Prefecture, where it was founded. The business is carried out by consolidated subsidiary Shonan Zeminaru.
